publicApis.name: console-created provider-bound Codex session
inputs: original mobile button labels without command text
acceptedStates: fresh Codex session with explicit configured profile
machine-scoped Codex console with its command consumer installed
rejectedStates: profile combined with restore or resume
publicApis.outputState: creation preserves its selected family; console account switching updates only that family global intent for the next actual input; current menu labels resolve to hidden commands
publicApis.enforcement: create-codex and switch-codex handlers, shared auth profile UI, spawn validation, runCodexConsole and createConsoleMenu

budgets.notApplicableReason: Creation reuses the existing daemon startup deadline; no new resource budget.

lifecycleTransitions.notApplicableReason: No new lifecycle states. The daemon Codex console is ready after its command callback is installed and reuses the machine console identity without a provider thread. Ordinary Codex creation and restore retain provider identity checks.

provenanceFields.notApplicableReason: The local endpoint validates profile identity and the existing session-selection record consumes global account intent.
